examples.title: Staff Accountant ($65-70k)
examples.llm: Your resume is an 83.3% match for the Staff Accountant position, showing a strong overall fit for the role. You successfully meet all key required qualifications, highlighted by your proficiency in Microsoft Excel, corporate accounting software like Oracle Financials and Microsoft Dynamics, and a strong understanding of accounting principles demonstrated through system implementations. Additionally, your background reflects the required effective communication and teamwork abilities needed for the job. There are no missing requirements identified in your profile for this posting.
examples.template: Strong fit (83/100). Your resume covers 4 of 4 required qualifications, including Corporate Accounting experience, Strong understanding of accounting principles and practices, Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Effective communication and teamwork abilities. The posting asks for 1+ years of experience; your resume shows ~25 years.

examples.title: Staff Accountant

However, your profile is missing key requirements such as an initiative-taking energetic approach and excellent oral and written communication skills.

examples.title: Accounting Specialist
examples.llm: Your resume achieves an overall match score of 45.5 for the Accounting Specialist position. You demonstrate a partial match in your ability to assess issues and initiate solutions through your experience structuring and negotiating financial institution documentation. However, the role requires several critical competencies that are currently missing from your profile, including proficient computer skills, Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, as well as strong written and verbal communication. Additionally, you lack evidence of attention to detail, being highly self-motivated, and preferred qualifications like an Enterprise Resource Planning system or DoD clearance.
